notes.title: NEWS #2 - 16 BIT NIGHTS
notes.content:
Hello players,


We have some important news regarding our 16 BIT NIGHTS company's future.


01 Welcome Back, Commander
The game has been released. We also provided a series of updates after release, and the game is now rock solid with a very positive rating.
Unfortunately, the actual sales were under our expectations, and my partner and I had a lot of arguing regarding this, so we decided to "part ways," which brings me to the next point.
You can check out the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015620/Welcome_Back_Commander/


02 NEW GAME #1
My partner will work on a new game without me. He will use the artwork I made for previous Chromosome Evil/Welcome Back Commander games, and he will also use the 16 BIT NIGHTS branding for publishing, so even though we parted ways, we are still working together to some extent.
He plans on experimenting with co-op multiplayer within an extraction squad-based type of gameplay.
More details soon.


03 NEW GAME #2
I will also work on a game, but I don't want to give out spoilers yet other than it will be a new IP with unique squad-based gameplay.
I will also be working on this one with a new partner.
In addition, this year, I will also try to focus more on our YouTube channel and make full playthroughs of our games with commentary.


04 NEW GAME #3
In collaboration with Real Heroes Studio, we would like to announce a big demo update on Desolated District on 27 April.
This is a fresh take for us since it's our first project as a collaborative effort with another developer studio. We have a minimal involvement rezumed to environment storytelling design, graffiti sprites, polish interface stage, design consultations, and marketing consultation.
The game is a 3D survival crafting with a nice magical touch within a Kowloon Walled City theme.
You can Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454070/Desolated_District/


05 Lovecraftian Days Fest
We would also like to announce that the  Lovecraftian Days steam festival hosted by Fulqrum publisher has started, and Welcome Back, Commander, along with Chromosome Evil and Chromosome Evil 2, are participating.
To celebrate this, we put together a new trailer that highlights some of the Lovecraftian-inspired bosses you can encounter in Welcome Back, Commander.
Trailer link: https://youtu.be/1HYEjJh_0eU
Link to event: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/lovecraftiandays2025


06 16 BIT NIGHTS bundle
For our hardcore fans who would like to support us in the future, we also updated our 16 BIT NIGHTS bundle with a discount on ALL our games:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29954/16_BIT_NIGHTS/


07 16 BIT NIGHTS Steam developer Page.
We have also established a Steam Developer Page for those of you who want to be notified of all our future official releases.
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/16bitnights







Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: NEWS - 16 BIT NIGHTS
notes.content:
Hi,

We have BIG news and a call to action.


Let's start.


1. Main Project "Welcome Back, Commander"

Well it happened, we remained out of funding at the beginning of this November but after serious consideration, we decided to push forward by using our personal economies which should allow us to extend development time until the middle of Q1 2025.

"Welcome Back, Commander" is set to have 2-3 hours of playthrough but high replay value and high production value. 

We are still in discussion on what the price will be but as a general idea, the game will cost a minimum 5$ - a maximum of 10$. 

We also need to decide what secondary monetization to have, some possibilities are still on the table, maybe you players can help us out with a vote?

A. we release the game for 5$ and if we get enough attention on the game we we will keep updating the main game version but increase the price gradually up to 20$ to cover development costs.
B. we release the game for 5$ and we also add one supporter DLC for 30$, it will have MINIMAL cosmetic content but it will be 100% optional as in just for the people who enjoyed our games to support us and if enough support on this DLC then we will keep pushing free content on the main game.
C. we release the game for 5$ and we add 3 content DLCs(extra maps, extra endings and other content) for 10$ each DLC.

CALL TO ACTION

Meantime if you want to support us, smash that wishlist button like u love it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015620/Welcome_Back_Commander/

We hope to have it released in Q1 of 2025.




2. Collaboration with "Real Heroes Studio"

So, a couple of weeks ago we met the solo dev from "Real Heroes Studio", he had a game called "Desolated District" in which we saw potential, and after some ideas exchange, we decided to help him out in his endeavors.

This will be an experimental collaboration for "16 Bit Nights". 
We will contribute to "Real Heroes Studio" with Marketing consultancy, environmental storytelling design, and some other minor investments.

If the experiment will turn out to have a positive outcome then we will consider investing in other small indie developers in the future.

CALL TO ACTION

You can smash that wishlist button and find this magical open-world-survival-crafting game on Steam here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454070/Desolated_District/ 

We hope to have it released in Q2 of 2025.







3. Overall situation

2025 will be a very risky year for us and we need all the support we can get.

If you want to support us, smash the wishlist buttons for "Welcome Back, Commander" and "Desolated District", smash it like you mean it!





Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/473aba5f241ed14640bf547425e93e09e28c262f.gif


UPDATE TIME
Bow&arrows are back


Good news, we managed to push one more big update for you!

A major update. Version 1.5x
. For those who have played recently:
1 Added a new bow weapon. At first, it is not strong, but it does not waste bullets, but consumes materials.
2 Improved ammo has been added:
-Enhanced. It just increases the hit damage.
Incendiary. If hit, there will be a chance to set fire to the target. Arrows are set on fire immediately. The target is constantly taking damage and will not live long.
Poisoned. If hit, there will be a chance to poison the target. Arrows infect immediately. The target slows down, weakens, and takes damage.
Explosive. Radically increase the damage. But we need to get to them...
-Weighted arrows throw off enemies.
3 Improved the burning and poisoning of enemies. Changed mechanics and damage. Also now they continue to burn and die even after losing their legs.
4 Everything except car repairs and mining can now be done on the go on the global map.


New enhanced ammunition types

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/472632ef8ad21a0e6c61b2719f984b80dfeb0f8d.png

For those who played around the release:
1 At least 3 times there was a serious revision of the balance of the game. The complexity has increased, global effects have been added, and mechanics that did not work well at first have been debugged.
2 Added story missions during evolutionary jumps. The evolution system has also been revised. Enemies now have weapons after clear stages.
3 The cards for the grind have been replenished.
4 A lot of management changes. Fighters are now much more responsive, less sticky when managing allocation. The change of equipment in the inventory has been greatly reduced.
5 Heavy mode is now really heavy.
For those who haven't played yet:
If you were in doubt whether to take the game or not, now is the time to play a demo version and see that the game has become much more enjoyable to manage.lp of feedback from the players, we managed to improve the gameplay, bring the balance to a pleasant level, and introduce several mechanics that made the game even more interesting. Now you will be able to see not a raw game, but one that is quite worthy of your attention. Since the release, many bugs have been fixed and many edits have been made to make it better. The game is not dead, but continues to improve and I am always open to suggestions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/4c87fb64b241d81be4b4ac608fa8947de468a0da.png

Want to support us?
 Join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/USFbBSBeTZ



regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: BIG UPDATE + news of our current situation.
notes.content:
Hey Players,

It's been 2 weeks since we released the game so now it's time to share some of the data behind the curtain, a summary, and a big update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/838bcc36757727d83f1c905d6f0a0d85ac93cf13.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/51f9b3b1af5df4a20f434d2c55a920f321c1b90e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/061dc48d57415ea084e4acb1ec0f0a4a3a70329a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/a68c264b7a7e23c683ca50b9aa91f2daa972f1fa.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/d662af5cee1dd56b35c600ef4eaaf06ea332aae1.png

First good news, Chromosome Evil 2 got approved for trading cards, we just uploaded the trading cards artwork and we are waiting for final confirmation, I estimate they should be dropping by the end of next week.



Summary since the release:

- bug fixing, my partner had a marathon in fixing bugs, it's hard to track but overall he made fixes each day since the release, and we must add here an addition Thank you players for having patience with us
- minor balance adjustments
- minor quality of life features

Today's BIG Update

- Re-balance, today a huge re-balance of the game took place, mele was to OP and the game lacked that dangerous element, we noticed in many videos that people would just grind everything, well no more, now you will need real survival skills
- New content, we added 5 evolution event scenarios(chapter 3) that will get triggered on certain evolution stages to spice up the survival experience.


WARNING: because we added a lot in this new update there might be some new bugs, if you encounter them please report them, and my partner will fix them.




Our current situation

Well unfortunately here the situation is not very good for us.
We failed to reach any of our major milestones in matter of sales and Steam engagement.

This was due to a number of factors, fortunately, the game quality is not one of them.

Right now we are on the floating line and we must consider our next move very carefully.
We probably have funding left to keep making games until the coming winter, so if any Game of Thrones fans around here know that for us the"winter is coming" expression is BRUTAL.



The future

We have read all the reviews and noticed that the people who played it liked our creation a lot, which brought joy to our hearts.
So, right now we are going to fix all bugs that get reported including balance adjustments.
And if the game will get serious attention from the player community in the future we will also consider adding more extra content to it.



Thank you, players!









Regards
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.content:

The most critical was a serious bug that caused random crashes at the start of the game or on load of a game.
Well good news everyone, that critical bug was fixed, unfortunately, it caused a serious drawback with our deadlines but we believe we can still handle it.

We apologize for any problems caused by this critical bug and we want to thank you all for not losing faith in us, there was one guy who despite this critical bug still gave us positive feedback, this truly heartwarming for us and we will do our best not to let you down.

This being said here is what was updated in the 14 days since the last update announcement:

1. BUG FIXES
-Global Map Pathfinding fix
-Double research
-wrong ammo icon
-pathfinding near cars
- 2 maps without top layer fix
-save train bug (makark0dy)
-shock hero effect bug (I'm S.W.A.T)

-usual prelude crash (makark0dy)
- high-level crawler crush
- part 1 base attack event
-Video settings changes in the core engine. Must fix crushes on first launch and options settings.

- Global map random encounters mechanics and encounters themselves

We released in Early access so that means the game is NOT finished and because we constantly push new content and fix bugs new bugs will occur, but rest assured we will fix them all as long as the bugs are reported on the bug report topic or on our discord.
I say this because I noticed some people expected finished clean games in Early access and if that is the case I strongly suggest you stay away from this game until the full release(somewhere in February we hope) and only try it out now if you want to get involved in its development and support the developers.
